directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on online dictionaries. You can start your essay with the sentence "Online dictionaries are becoming increasingly popular. " You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
Online dictionaries are becoming increasingly popular. To begin with, they offer unparalleled convenience. Unlike traditional paper dictionaries, online ones can be accessed anytime and anywhere as long as there is an internet connection. For example, when you are reading an e-book on your phone and come across an unfamiliar word, you can quickly look it up without having to carry a heavy dictionary.

In addition, online dictionaries provide a wealth of information. They not only give the basic definitions but also offer examples of usage, synonyms, antonyms, and even pronunciation guides. This comprehensive information helps users understand words more thoroughly.

Furthermore, online dictionaries often have features that enhance the learning experience. Some can track your search history, allowing you to review the words you've looked up. Others offer word-of-the-day features to expand your vocabulary.
In conclusion, the convenience, rich information, and useful features make online dictionaries a popular choice for language learners and users in general.
